Welcome to our 44th Season! ALL CONCERTS FREE!

I’m thrilled to announce our 2026–2027 concert season, featuring an exciting lineup of exceptional musical talent. Thanks to our generous sponsors and grantors, the entire season will be free of charge!

We’ll continue our 4:30 PM pre-concert talks, followed by performances at 5 PM, with complimentary wine and light bites at our post-concert receptions. All concerts will take place at Christ Church Episcopal, 21 Aurora Street, in beautiful downtown Hudson.
